title: Reload Saved Scenes mistaken unsaved project settings with unsaved scenes
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.5.1.stable, v4.6.dev.custom_build [78d91947f]

### System information

Godot v4.6.dev (78d91947f) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon, 24 Nov 2025 15:21:09 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (nvidia; 580.105.08) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13400F (16 threads) - 15.37 GiB memory

### Issue description

After modifying some Project Settings, the Reload Saved Scenes option in the File menu thinks it's the current scene that's been modified, so it prompts for saving it.

This happens even for scenes that's opened _after_ modifying the project settings.

Closing the scene tab works correctly without thinking it as been modified.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/84284ecc-cb48-45c0-b4a6-a84dd412512c

### Steps to reproduce

1. Project > Project Settings
2. Change some settings
3. Close the dialog
4. Open a scene, so it's clear that the scene is never modified
5. File > Reload Saved Scenes
6. Check that a prompt appears claiming that the scene has unsaved changes.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
